question: Which of the following folk dances is NOT associated with Goa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghumura**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dashavatara**, **Dekhni**, and **Dhangar** are all folk dances associated with Goa.
 
• **Ghumura** is a traditional folk dance from the Kalahandi district in Odisha and is not associated with Goa.
